visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing glasses and a black t-shirt with a red lanyard enters a workspace and sits down. He places a large red carton of McDonald's french fries on a wooden desk next to a black tablet. (2) Multiple hands reach into the frame from different sides, grabbing handfuls of fries from the carton. The man gestures frantically to stop them, but the fries disappear rapidly. (3) The man displays a look of extreme emotional distress, opening his mouth wide in a silent scream and clutching his head. He then collapses to the floor in a brightly lit hallway, looking up with tears in his eyes while holding the empty red carton. (4) A second man with long black dreadlocks, a headband, and a light-colored robe (the Master) appears. He holds up a hand-drawn paper manual with a sketch of a character and Chinese text. (5) The young man remains seated on the floor, looking skeptical. The Master then reveals three more hand-drawn manuals, fanning them out like cards. (6) The young man is shown in a series of fast-cut shots, performing stylized martial arts blocks and strikes. He wears the same black t-shirt and lanyard, and digital smoke effects swirl around his hands. (7) The man sits back at his desk, smiling. He pours a red seasoning packet into a white McDonald's paper bag, rolls the top, and shakes it vigorously before eating a seasoned fry and gesturing toward the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A moderate male voice speaks in a casual conversational tone. There is a faint indoor room tone in the background. (2) A rapid series of overlapping voices, both male and female, excitedly speak short phrases in Mandarin. A rhythmic electronic percussion beat begins to build. (3) A sudden, high-pitched male scream erupts with intense vocal strain and high arousal. The BGM cuts out, replaced by a low, dramatic synth drone. (4) A deeper male voice speaks with slow, authoritative prosody. A high-frequency electronic shimmer sound effect is heard as a paper is handled. (5) Frequent 'whoosh' and 'impact' sound effects punctuate the mix in a rapid sequence. The BGM swells into a high-energy cinematic electronic track with a heavy kick drum. (6) The primary male voice transitions to a bright, friendly promotional tone. Audible paper rustling and a rhythmic shaking sound are prominent before the music ends with a sharp stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous martial arts parody to promote McDonald's McShaker Fries. It depicts the frustration of sharing fries with coworkers and presents the 'McShaker' experience as a reward worth mastering techniques to protect and enjoy.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product, official McDonald's branding, and a concluding call-to-action regarding a promotional offer.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video leverages popular martial arts tropes and social-media-friendly editing to create an engaging short-form commercial.
